title: Origin story: Sinbad
description: Sinbad the Sailor of Baghdad made seven voyages, each a catalog of wonders: islands that were whales, the Old Man of the Sea, the valley of diamonds, the roc's egg. He returned rich each time, squandered it, and sailed again — telling his tales to Sinbad the Porter, his landlocked namesake.
